Name: Make Your Room
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#00ffff][size=5]This mod takes a bit of work, but you can totally make the room your own.[/size][/color]

[size=3]Build "[color=#ffff00]Make Your Room[/color]", which will be added to Robin's build menu, on your farm.
Create ceilings, walls, partitions, etc. by installing "[color=#ffff00]parts[/color]" that will be added to the craft menu and then using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] to change their appearance.
Floor changes are made using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]mod config[/url] in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

Currently the only decoration on the walls is flowers.
Other decorations will be added in updates.

There is a trick that makes it a little easier when using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] to make multiple pieces look the same.
[youtube]aNQ78QVgQnU[/youtube]
As in the video, after the first selection, you move the cursor to the next part by moving yourself without moving the mouse.
In this way, the appearance of the parts can be changed continuously without moving the mouse.


[color=#00ff00]There are some mods that are recommended, but not required, to make this mod easier to handle and even better.[/color]

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][size=3]By ignoring walls when installing parts or changing the look of the room in AT, you can now create a comfortable room.

[/size][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2736][size=3]Movement Speed[/size][/url]
[/list][size=3]When making room, temporarily increasing the tool's swing speed makes it easier to remove parts.

[/size][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14780][size=3]Dynamic Flooring[/size][/url]
[/list][size=3]This is strongly recommended.[/size]
[size=3]The "Dynamic Flooring Mod", which allows you to lay the floor as you like, works very well with this mod.[/size]



[color=#ffff00][size=4]Added in version 1.1.[/size][/color]
Various parts in "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interior[/url]" colors were added.


[size=5][color=#00ffff]We are still planning to add more things in the update.[/color]
